comment: Named losses of the registry top-1 gate (registry-gate.js): dev-lesson cases recorded passing in registry-top1.json that no longer rank their lesson first. Each entry names the case, the lesson it now loses to, and why. A stale entry fails; the list empties when registry-top1.json is regenerated.

losses.name: artifacts
losses.reason: keyword-first ranking replaced RRF as search.js's default: the keyword layer ranks L112 first and L135 second; under RRF L135's better TF-IDF rank (6 vs 9) had lifted it above L112.

losses.name: /dream
losses.reason: keyword-first ranking replaced RRF as search.js's default: the keyword layer ranks L62 first and L101 second; under RRF L101's TF-IDF rank 1 (L62: 2) broke the swapped-rank tie in its favour.
